propositions: Mapped but nonexistent or permission-denied Jira project keys pass syntactic validation but fail only during fan-out mutation with ACLI errors (05b8-4efe-8d58-4c27 incident class).
legacy_default is returned unvalidated by resolve_project, causing unbound tickets to create in wrong projects when legacy_default points to an inaccessible or wrong project.
Preflight must validate every project in the mapped set, legacy_default, and configured query_project fallback is visible and accessible to the bridge bot via Jira REST API before any mutation.
Preflight must gate only mutating passes (not preview/dry-run/reconcile-check) and only when backend is 'jira'; non-Cloud backends and missing _direct_rest_get capability are skipped observably.

Visibility probe must paginate through GET /rest/api/3/project/search with hard page-cap fail-closed, and map transport/auth errors to distinct TransportUnavailableError separate from ProjectVisibilityError.
Preflight abort converts to OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult with actionable message naming missing/invisible keys before reconcile_once is called, preventing outbound writes on visibility failure.
